name: fxr_fall_stairs083
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/fall_stairs083_lake.state, its own provenance: from the save point's state (loc 084, the playthrough's sanctum) the ROM's own loader into loc 083 above the staircase that is a conveyor for good (--teleport 0x83 32 35 1, method jmp, 120 frames). Which staircase is a slide is the room's fn1 (scene 131 obj0 0x00E9: `53 FE 00 0B / 67 18 0B`, glb[254] bits 3/4 = the trap that was sprung): the playthrough fell down the right one (obj31's 0x0769 sets bit 3: the conveyor copied at tile (31,36)), the owner's game the left one (bit 4: (10,36), where the capture stood at (11,35)); the twin stands at the top of its own slide, (32,35).
